name: F4d_circle_radius_near_zero
sw_rationale: Family 4 (Near-degenerate). A circle constrained to radius 0.001 (near-zero). SolidWorks allows sub-millimeter circles (used in sketch fillets of very small features). The solver must converge without division-by-zero. Expected: converged=true, r=0.001, no NaN. Confidence HIGH for convergence behavior (graceful handling).

expect._coord_notes: circle center=(0,0), r=0.001. Must not NaN or diverge.
